name: aquilla
description: Agentic translation management for Bible and mission content: project status, quality, terminology and staged changes that a person approves.

interface.shortDescription: Translation project status, quality and approvals
interface.longDescription: Aquilla runs Bible and mission translation projects. Connect it to ask where a project stands, which books or files need attention, and whether key terms are used consistently. Aquilla can also draft changes, but every change is staged first: you review it in Aquilla and approve it before anything is saved.
defaultPrompt: Write a status report on my Aquilla projects
Which files in my project need attention this week?
Check my project for inconsistent key terms
